focus_areas: Texture realism of the rice and sauce
Spatial grounding of the pan against the background
Verification of handle attachment points and hanging hole visibility
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interface between the rice and the pan wall; AI often struggles with the precise contact line where food meets a curved container. Also, verify if the reflections on the pan's inner wall are consistent with a single light source. Specifically check if the OVD confirms the absence of a hanging hole or rivets, validating the 'not visible' status.
image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a black frying pan (skillet) containing white rice topped with an orange sauce or seasoning. The pan has a visible handle extending to the right. In the background, there are other dining items including a small bowl with red specks, chopsticks in a holder, and a red object (possibly a tomato or container). The lighting is somewhat dim with strong reflections on the metallic/seasoned surfaces.
